userIntent: Continue the Bauman Hub carefully and continuously; fix all Chat-owned work first, then hand off only the runtime work that genuinely requires Codex.
objective: Remove mock/stale learner-facing truth from the five Hub primary routes, introduce explicit data-truth handling for missing/stale/local values, and rewrite regression so it protects truth rather than reference samples.
targetArea: Bauman Hub learner-facing read models and primary-page decorators
forbiddenPaths: subject private storage, DB, DOM or assessment/mastery internals
requiredContracts: Primary navigation remains exactly home, roadmap, subjects, schedule, research.
Missing data is not silently converted to zero or a decorative fallback.
Sample/reference values never render as learner truth.
LOCAL_HUB checklists/notes/tasks remain explicitly local and non-authoritative.
Subject integration uses only declared public capability/launch contracts; no subject-internal reads.
Current canonical schedule/research/curriculum owners remain intact.
No new primary page is introduced.

evidence: assets/js/subjects-reference-v1.js defines COURSE_REF with hard-coded lecturer/session/date/fallbackProgress values.
subjectProgress(id,fallback) returns the reference fallback when canonical progress is 0 or missing.
Subjects summary hard-codes 63%, fixed attention counts and fixed AI suggestion counts.
Research summary hard-codes 65% completion, Chapter 3 and fixed deadline/AI counts.
The module patches app.research to render this reference workspace.
tests/thesis-reference-v1-static.mjs requires the 65% KPI, Chapter 3 and fixed suggestion/deadline copy.
tests/thesis-reference-v1-browser.mjs requires 16 reference events and fixed AI/milestone counts.
tests/subjects-reference-v1-browser.mjs requires thirteen course cards, four AI suggestions and a 2025 calendar interaction.
schedule-reference-v1 progress panel maps missing progress to 0.
hub-primary-pages-v6 subject hero maps missing progress through pct() to 0.

architectureInvariants: main.js remains the Hub route/state semantic owner unless an explicit architecture migration is justified.
Presentation modules may decorate/project but cannot invent learner data authority.
Research topic content in current Hub data may be shown; learner progress must come from explicit evidence/status.
A real zero is distinct from UNAVAILABLE.
LOCAL_HUB research checklist completion is not mastery/assessment.
implementationPhases: P1 — Reconfirm exact current main and diff from packet baseline; if main moved, inspect only impacted Hub owners before editing.
P2 — Define the smallest normalized Hub truth helper/read model. Reuse an existing owner if it already supports provenance/status; create hub-data-truth.js only if duplication would otherwise remain.

P3 — Subjects: eliminate seeded learner-facing teachers/dates/session counts/fallback progress. Project canonical state/data; user-created local overrides may remain LOCAL_HUB. Render unavailable/stale labels explicitly.

P4 — Research: stop seeding reference week/tasks/milestones/chapter percentages/heatmap as learner truth. Project canonical RESEARCH_TOPICS/state.researchChecks and clearly separated LOCAL_HUB notes/tasks only when the user creates them.
P5 — Home/Roadmap/Schedule/primary decorators: distinguish real zero from missing progress; propagate status/freshness instead of Number(x)||0.
P6 — Replace reference-sample regression assertions with truth-state, ownership, route-isolation, interaction and responsive assertions.
P7 — Run targeted static tests, direct browser tests at desktop/mobile, then affected Hub regression. Fix root causes and retest until green.
P8 — Write CURRENT_EXECUTION_RESULT.json with exact before/after SHA, changed paths and evidence. Do not deploy production.
acceptanceCriteria: No active learner-facing Subjects/Research surface seeds March 2025 reference data as current learner data.
No active learner-facing progress projection maps missing/unknown to numeric 0.
A genuine stored progress value of 0 remains valid and distinguishable from unavailable.
No regression test requires the old mock KPI/course/event counts merely to pass.
Subjects still opens declared subject routes/capabilities without reading subject internals.
Schedule retains manual/auto scheduling behavior and priority interactions.
Research retains topic/checklist functionality with LOCAL_HUB labeling for local evidence.
Desktop and 390x844 mobile browser tests have no horizontal overflow or console/page errors.
Targeted static and browser tests pass at one exact afterSha.
testPlan: Add/run Hub data-truth tests covering CURRENT/STALE/UNAVAILABLE/LOCAL_HUB, real zero, missing values and stale values.
Run hub-premium-responsive-browser and any current primary-route smoke gate affected by changed owners.
Verify no files under forbidden paths changed.

crossCutting: PWA/package asset references if a new helper is added

releasePolicy: No merge until exact-head static + browser acceptance passes. No production deployment from this packet. Production remains a separate explicit release gate.
rollbackNotes: Rollback target is main@db747b1e6c65e5eb2a28cfd7ea2aeee8e3f9872c for runtime changes; preserve any later unrelated main commits by reverting only the packet merge if needed.

scopeExpansions.reason: Truth-safe Research correctly removes seeded Thesis event/AI rows, exposing a regression test that assumed optional sample content was mandatory. The new hub-data-truth tests also need an existing CI execution path.
invariants: Do not weaken typography thresholds for content that exists.
When optional content is unavailable, assert an explicit readable unavailable state instead of requiring fake rows.
Run hub-data-truth static/browser tests in the existing Whole System Integration workflow.
